title: ArtifactContentTopology
description: Topology content payload for kind=topology. Stores a declarative Topology v2 view binding; topology-service resolves graph data at render time.

binding.description: Declarative render binding for a Topology v2 view.

source.description: Service that owns topology view resolution.

viewId.description: Topology v2 view identifier to resolve or stream.

timeMode.description: Whether the artifact resolves a fixed asOf topology or current topology.

asOf.description: Fixed-time resolve timestamp. Required by tool validation when timeMode=fixed and omitted/null when timeMode=current.

presentation.description: Optional UI presentation hints for topology artifact rendering.

overlayState.description: Durable current overlay/layer projection for same-artifact visual follow-ups.
